text:
ash: Quick heads-up for tomorrow's 11am PT sync: cross-cloud marketplace rollout for H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. Need to align embargo cascade, thermal mitigations (EU/APAC caps), and the fallback/circuit-breaker routing we discussed.

mina: calendar invite sent. Agenda: 1) freeze dates + exact vendor tags 2) cross-region embargo cascade (who goes first?) 3) SI handoff + peering tests 4) automation: preview->public cutover + fallback routing rules.

derek: perf update: H200 still shows a mid-run dip on 6k seq in APAC racks; suspect thermal headroom + firmware governor. we need partner assurance on a power patch or reduced TDP image.

kristen: labs note  west/central lab can run multi-node H200/MI300 on Thu/Fri if canaries arrive by Tue noon and are signed. EU lab capacity limited; suggest staging EU preview one week after US preview.

simon: adding ops: infra-bot, please remind the team of region power caps. infra-bot: any quick notes?

infra-bot: EU rack steady power limit is ~8% lower than US-west. APAC nodes have occasional 10-15% inlet temp spikes during daytime. Recommend setting region_power_limit in SKU metadata and adding thermal_counters_required=true.

ash: vendor-bot, can partners post their canonical canary tags and confirm thermal counter exposure? we need fields to align on: sku_tag, driver_tag, fw_tag, thermal_exporter_version.

vendor-bot: Vendors published tentative tags: h100-fw:2024-11-02, h200-canary:v20241104, b200-img:v20241103, mi300-fw:2024-10-28, gaudi-driver:v2.7. Thermal exporter v0.5 available; sampling to 50ms supported.

mina: thanks. marketing asks for a 7-day embargo prep buffer after driver freeze for partner quotes and docs. proposal: embargo cascade = US -> EU -> APAC, spaced 7 days. That lets SI teams finish region-specific peering.

derek: timeline risk: H200 timeline tight. propose fallback orchestration: during preview, if per-customer long-seq regression >8% vs our baseline, route that customer to fallback_model_tag (b200-stable) automatically and notify the partner and customer. We should also have an automated rollback if regression >15% cluster-wide.

kristen: labs can simulate the routing by toggling marketplace_flag test.preview_fallback=true; SI teams want a sample IaC snippet for how to validate peering + routing. I'll paste a short example in-thread.

```
# example: preview routing feature flag (yaml)
preview_feature:
  name: crosscloud-fallback
  rules:
    - condition: "long_seq_regression_pct > 8"
      action: route_to: "b200-stable"
    - condition: "cluster_regression_pct > 15"
      action: rollback_preview: true
```

mina: perfect. vendors: if you can't enable thermal-exporter at 50ms, we won't be able to run the derate correlation; please reply with "ACK + exporter_version".

vendor-bot: H200 vendor: ACK + thermal-exporter v0.5. H100 vendor: ACK + exporter v0.5. MI300 vendor: ACK + exporter v0.4 (50ms coming in next build).

derek: SI asks: we need signed canary images + a small reference dataset (5 short prompts, 3 long prompts) and a smoke harness. SI: please confirm you'll run boot, nvlink, driver sanity, single-node latency, multi-node long-seq throughput, and thermal trace capture.

simon: copying the smoke checklist (short) for visibility: boot + firmware validate; nvlink + interconnect; driver load + rocm/cuda quick sanity; single-node 1-stream latency; multi-node long-seq throughput (4k-12k seq); KV cache replay correctness; thermal trace capture @50ms sample.

kristen: marketing embargo proposal pasted below: driver freeze -> 7 days partner buffer -> US preview -> 7 day wait -> EU preview -> 7 day wait -> APAC preview -> public listing 3 days after last preview if no regressions. Vendors: confirm freeze dates so we can lock windows.

mina: draft cross-cloud timeline (needs vendor confirmation):
- H100/B200: canary Nov 4-5 -> driver freeze Nov 9 -> US preview Nov 17 -> EU preview Nov 24 -> APAC preview Dec 1 -> public Dec 4
- H200: canary Nov 6-8 -> extended perf Nov 9-15 -> driver freeze Nov 16 -> US preview Nov 24 -> EU preview Dec 1 -> APAC preview Dec 8 -> public Dec 11 (fallback active on preview)
- MI300/Gaudi: canary Nov 10-14 -> perf Nov 15-21 -> driver freeze Nov 22 -> US preview Nov 30 -> EU preview Dec 7 -> APAC preview Dec 14 -> public Dec 17

derek: H200 still looks risky on dates; ask partners to confirm whether they can expedite thermal mitigation or provide a reduced-TDP image for EU/APAC. If not, we should stagger H200 previews further.

vendor-bot: H200 vendor: requesting extra perf run data; will try to deliver reduced-TDP image by Nov 20 if tests support it. Will confirm "ACK + reduced-tdp-tag" in 48h.

simon: action items (I'll collate): 1) vendors post "ACK + fw/driver/canary tags + exporter_version" (vendors) 2) SI provide IaC peering snippets + run smoke harness (SI leads) 3) perf team run derate correlation with exporter traces on canaries (derek/simon) 4) marketplace: add fields to SKU schema (region_power_limit, thermal_counters_required, fallback_model_tag, recommended_quant) (mina) 5) marketing confirm embargo cascade (kristen) 6) labs carve EU/US windows and require signed images 48h prior (kristen).

kristen: will reserve labs and post the IaC snippets after the call. please reply in-thread with short ACKs so I can turn this into minutes. Example: "ACK + h200-canary:v20241104 + exporter v0.5".

ash: one more ask  include a quick troubleshooting template in marketplace docs for SI: what to collect when customers report throttling (logs, thermal traces, inlet temps, trace IDs). helps reduce back-and-forth.

infra-bot: Addendum: auto-notify channels #eng-runtime and #support when fallback routing triggers; include trace_id and customer_id in the alert.

mina: thanks all. I'll compile minutes and action list post-call. reply with "ACK + tags" in-thread. :white_check_mark:
